features.name: Index an entire drive
features.description: Point FileHQ at a drive or folder and it records every file — path, size, created/modified dates, extension — into one searchable catalogue.
features.notes: os.walk scanner; ~2,858,834 files currently indexed across 26 scans

features.name: Incremental re-scan
features.description: Re-scanning only touches new or changed files instead of re-reading everything, so keeping the index fresh is fast.
features.notes: Compares stored modified_date + size; resets hashes on change

features.name: Skip the noise
features.description: System and junk folders (Recycle Bin, System Volume Information, node_modules, .git, __pycache__) and junk files (Thumbs.db, desktop.ini) are skipped automatically.

features.name: Drive & size insights
features.description: See usage by drive letter, the largest files, and totals — answers 'what is taking up space?' instantly from the index.
features.notes: db_drive_usage / db_largest_files in the Naya bridge

features.name: Auto-categorize by type
features.description: Every file is grouped into Photos, Videos, Music, Documents, Software, Archives, Scripts, or Data by its extension — Other for anything unknown.

features.name: Archive era tagging
features.description: Files are tagged FORWARD (2020 onward) or BACKWARD (before 2020) plus their year, so old and current material can be separated when organizing.

features.name: Category breakdown report
features.description: A live count and total size per category and era, ready for the dashboard or a chat answer.

features.name: Find exact duplicates
features.description: FileHQ fingerprints files and groups byte-for-byte identical copies together, so you can see every duplicate of every file.
features.notes: xxhash64 full-hash grouping; 694 groups / 1,618 members currently

features.name: Fast staged hashing
features.description: Only files that could possibly be duplicates are hashed — first by matching size, then a cheap partial hash, and only then a full hash. Unique files are never fully read.
features.notes: Three-phase pipeline in hasher.py — size -> partial 64KB -> full

features.name: Keep the original
features.description: Within each duplicate group the oldest copy is marked as the keeper, so a clean-up never removes the original.

features.name: Wasted-space estimate
features.description: See how much space duplicates are wasting, and which groups waste the most, before deciding what to remove.

features.name: Review workflow
features.description: Each duplicate group can be marked pending / reviewed / resolved and assigned an action (delete, move, or rename) before anything happens.

features.name: Near-duplicate / similarity detection
features.description: Detect files that are similar but not byte-identical (e.g. re-encoded video, resized photo) rather than only exact copies.

features.name: Plan an archive tidy-up
features.description: FileHQ proposes where each file should live in a canonical ARCHIVE folder tree, as a preview — nothing is moved.

features.name: Execute with one safeguard
features.description: Approved moves are carried out and every operation is logged so it can be undone.
features.notes: executor.execute_plan(); requires explicit owner approval via bridge

features.name: Undo a batch
features.description: Any batch of moves or a single duplicate action can be reversed from the operations log.

features.name: Exception rules
features.description: Define patterns to skip or re-categorize so personal/company folders are never touched.

features.name: Scheduled scans & dedup
features.description: Recurring scan and duplicate-detection jobs can be scheduled so the index stays current without manual effort.
features.notes: APScheduler + tasks table; defaults 24h scan / weekly dedup, no tasks defined yet

features.name: Database health & cleanup
features.description: Report the database size and reclaim space by VACUUMing, pruning missing files, and purging resolved duplicate groups.

features.name: Answer file questions in chat
features.description: Ask Naya about your files in plain language and it answers from live FileHQ data — duplicates, largest files, categories, drive usage, totals.
features.notes: filehq_bridge.build_context_for_prompt() injects live data into Naya's LLM prompt

features.name: Chat-driven actions
features.description: Trigger a scan, hashing, or a duplicate summary just by asking; Naya detects the intent and runs the safe action.
features.notes: detect_action() + execute_chat_action(); destructive ops blocked without approval

features.name: Telegram file commands
features.description: /files scan | dupes | largest | cats | drives | report | maintain — run FileHQ from Telegram.

features.name: Read-only by default
features.description: Naya reads the FileHQ index freely; moving or deleting files always requires an explicit 'you may proceed'.

features.name: File-search API to the ecosystem
features.description: Other QI projects can search the file index over a simple REST endpoint.
features.notes: GET /api/files/search (filename LIKE); registry advertises content extraction (not yet built)
